**Claim amendment: seat ruling (2) narrowed after measurement** · `domain:spec` seat 3 · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP` · 2026-10-28T09:22Z · same claim (6465227713), same branch `claude/project-thread-9k357q`.

**Measured by the dev at start (main `6866e2e7`).** On form views, every read of the five split / drawer parameter keys sits under a retired `type`. But `FormViewSchema` is also the schema source of the React `ObjectForm` block contract (`packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts` dataProps). That block reads `splitDirection`, `drawerSide` and `drawerWidth`, and its `formType: 'drawer' | 'split'` survives here, because `DrawerForm` stays a caller container per the ruling. Tombstoning those three would also regenerate `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` and make the PR governed (Tier H).

**Ruling (2), as applied:** a key that a live reader reads on a surviving surface stays.
- **Tombstoned in this PR:** `section.pane`, `splitSize`, `splitResizable`.
- **Kept, and named in the PR's Acceptance notes:** `splitDirection`, `drawerSide`, `drawerWidth`. They pass to the renderer card #27159, which owns the block contract (scope note 6465248799, edited). The PR carries `Refs #27153`, not `Part of`: the drawer half of #27153 stays open (seat note 6465263085, edited).

**File surface**, replacing the claim's: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (`FormViewSchema.type`, `section.pane`, `splitSize`, `splitResizable`) and its tests, the ADR-0087 disposition, the liveness ledger, regenerated baselines / forms / docs / ui manifest, `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/task.view.ts`, one changeset per touched published package.

**Claim amendment 2: the Studio form-type choosers and the ui pins that assert the retired values** · `domain:spec` seat 3 · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP` · 2026-10-28T09:54Z · same claim (6465227713), same branch `claude/project-thread-9k357q`.

**Measured by the dev (static reading, to be confirmed with a ui run).** The narrowing reaches `ui/**` outside the renderer branches in two ways.
- **Studio offers the retired values.** Studio's view-create form offers all six form types (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/anchors.ts` ~:289, `default-schemas.ts` ~:223). It writes `config.type` from that choice, so after this PR a `split` / `drawer` / `modal` pick produces a body the server refuses. That is a defect this PR would create.
- **ui tests pin the retired values as accepted.** `app-shell` `view-create-body.test.ts` (~:97, ~:145) and `plugin-form` `__tests__/formSectionGroupReference-7051.test.tsx` (~:478, ~:484) assert that the spec accepts them, and possibly two more test files that author `pane`.

**Ruling: A, widen.** A defect this PR creates is fixed in this PR, the precedent being #26804, which fixed its own Studio inspector. The file surface gains:
- the two Studio enum lists, narrowed to `simple | tabbed | wizard`;
- every ui test whose assertion this narrowing makes false, re-pinned to the new truth (a retired value refused, never deleted to get green);
- an `@object-ui/app-shell` changeset line, plus `@object-ui/plugin-form` if one of its tests moves only.

The fences stand: ⛔ `ObjectForm.tsx`, `ModalForm.tsx`, `SplitForm`, `react-blocks.ts`, `component.zod.ts`, `docs/adr/**` and `skills/**` remain #27159's or out of scope. Stop on breach and explain.

**Claim amendment 3** · `domain:spec` seat 3 · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP` · 2026-10-28T10:13Z · same claim (6465227713), same branch `claude/project-thread-9k357q`.

The full build found one more Studio site that the narrowing makes false. It is the same class as amendment 2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/package-schema.ts` (~:118), `getPackageForm()`, is spec-typed and returns `type: 'modal'`, which now fails TS2322.

Ruling: it is in this PR's surface, respelled `type: 'simple'`. Its only reader, `SectionedSchemaForm`, branches on `formType === 'tabbed'` alone, so the render is unchanged. `PackageFormDialog` stays the dialog container. Any further `app-shell` site the build or type-check finds of the same class (a spec-typed literal of a retired value) is in the surface too, and is named in the PR body. The fences from amendment 2 stand.
